title: Control build cost for a million-page catalog
businessContext: generateStaticParams enumerates every record and each page performs several serial network calls.
problemStatement: Design the system for 1,000,000 slugs; 10-minute build budget; origin limited to 100 concurrent reads. Produce the component/data-flow diagram, request and mutation contracts, cache/trust boundaries, capacity assumptions, failure recovery and rollout gates. State which decisions change between Next.js 15 and 16 instead of using a framework API as a substitute for an architectural guarantee.
constraints: Bound build time and origin concurrency.
candidateTasks: Draw components and annotate ownership of data, identity, caches and durable work.
Specify contracts/schema and quantify the capacity/freshness assumptions.
Walk through the failure scenario and design measurable acceptance tests.
Compare the reference decisions and answer the changed-requirement interview prompt.

systemDesignReqs.scale: 1,000,000 slugs; 10-minute build budget; origin limited to 100 concurrent reads
functional: Bound build time and origin concurrency.
nonFunctional: State an explicit latency, freshness and recovery budget rather than inventing guarantees.
Keep actor/tenant isolation and failure ownership observable.
assumptions: A patched App Router deployment; platform-specific infrastructure support must be verified.
Next.js version and Cache Components configuration are explicit design inputs.

hints: Measure a representative cold/warm build and enumerate only a bounded valuable set when the deployment model supports on-demand generation.

A broad rebuild during an origin incident can turn a serving site into a failed deployment. Retain the last verified artifact and separate deploy-time availability from the ongoing stale/fresh serving policy.
alternativeApproaches: It may move the bottleneck to memory, the database or remote rate limits. Increase concurrency only against measured capacity and error/latency budgets; cached inputs and smaller graphs can be more effective.
commonMistakes: Claiming a cache API provides transactions, durable delivery or cross-region consistency.
Omitting authorization, recovery budgets or evidence from an otherwise attractive component diagram.

verification: Run an origin-counted scale sample and extrapolate with measured bottlenecks.
Request unenumerated and deleted slugs after deployment.
Fail the origin mid-build and test rollback/retained-serving behavior.
nextjsPractice.next15: Use patched Next.js 15 and the router family named by the file path. Await request APIs where the App Router contract requires it; validate behavior in a production build.
nextjsPractice.next16: Applies to Next.js 16.4.5. Cache Components is disabled unless the exercise explicitly enables it. The simulator itself remains on 16.4.3.
